card.name: Harry Potter book titles in reference lists
card.fires_on: Words inside Harry Potter book or game titles, such as 'the', 'Chapter', 'Hallows' and the colon, in wiki-style reference and link lists.

modes.label: Linking words in titles
modes.description: The word 'the' or a punctuation mark inside a Harry Potter title in a list of links.
modes.example: Harry Potter and<< the>> Order of the Phoenix - ↑

modes.label: Chapter citations
modes.description: The word 'Chapter' or the title end just before a chapter number in a footnote list.
modes.example: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows,<< Chapter>> 10 - ↑ Harry Potter
